description: The model catalog: what every video or image model can do — resolutions, durations, aspect ratios, audio, reference limits, price per second or per image — grouped by capability class with a one-line explanation per group. Read this before choosing a `tool` for lab_generate/lab_animate/lab_propose; copy ids verbatim. Cached briefly; `stand` says how fresh. Without `klasse` the answer is COMPACT (one line per model, cheapest first, plus `klassen` with every valid class name): fields that are null, false or empty are left out, and a model that also belongs to another class shows there only as a short stub whose `wie_in` names the class holding its full entry. `form: knapp` means the catalog was too large for one answer — set `klasse` for the details. With `klasse` or `voll: true` every field. Filter to answer the usual question directly: `aufloesung`, `dauer_s`, `ton` (ohne = models that can run silent, including switchable audio). A model with switchable audio is listed under the class with AND without sound (i2v_ton and i2v).

aufloesung.description: Only models offering this resolution, e.g. 540p

dauer_s.description: Only models that can render this duration in seconds

eu.description: Only models allowed in EU mode projects (data stays inside the EU data path). Every model carries `eu_modus` and, where false, `eu_grund` — the first missing proof (`form: knapp` carries only `eu_modus`)

klasse.description: Only one capability class — the valid names are listed under `klassen` in every answer

ton.description: ohne = can run without sound (audio nie or schaltbar); mit = can make sound

voll.description: Every field of every model even without klasse — large, use a filter with it

name: lab_list_models
title: Model Catalog
